frequency_question: Among comparable highly partisan election bills introduced in a divided legislature, how often does one chamber pass it within 365 days?
membership_rule: Includes major federal election procedure or voter eligibility bills introduced in the U.S. Congress that feature strict partisan divisions; excludes bipartisan consensus technical adjustments.
coverage_note: 6 named major legislative vehicles; believed roughly 8-10 total distinct major pushes in modern history
known_gaps: Excludes minor committee-level markers that never reached floor votes.
skeleton: 6 named benchmark bills across 3 decades representing major partisan electoral integrity push attempts
multiplier: 3 hits out of 6 major legislative pushes achieving passage in at least one chamber
validity_reason: Institutional polarization dynamics remain stable over medium-term congressional sessions.
